answer.label: Not Nora Ephron alone — her account credits Billy Crystal
answer.sourceLine: Nora Ephron’s Academy of Achievement interview explicitly credits Billy Crystal with suggesting this customer’s line. In the finished film it is delivered by Estelle Reiner, not spoken by Ephron as personal advice. Source and attribution evidence ↗

source.heading: The source
trail: Nora Ephron’s Academy of Achievement interview explicitly credits Billy Crystal with suggesting this customer’s line. In the finished film it is delivered by Estelle Reiner, not spoken by Ephron as personal advice. Source and attribution evidence ↗

Ephron describes a collaborative read-through involving Meg Ryan and Rob Reiner. Her account distinguishes the screenplay’s author, the suggested punch line’s contributor, and the actor who performs it. Read the supporting source ↗

schema.claimReviewed: Nora Ephron originated the customer’s punch line “I’ll have what she’s having” in When Harry Met Sally.
schema.faqAnswer: Nora Ephron credits Billy Crystal with suggesting the customer’s punch line during their collaboration on When Harry Met Sally. Estelle Reiner performs it in the film. Ephron herself repeats the words in her interview while explaining Crystal’s contribution, so the correction concerns creation of the punch line, not whether she ever spoke those words.
